Running it
----------
simcity.mgt is a disk image for the SAM Coupe.  Put it in drive 1 and
boot it (F9).  In SimCoupe, insert the image as Disk 1.

The game uses screen mode 4 (256 x 192, 16 colours) and the SAA 1099 for
sound effects, played from the frame interrupt.  Cities are saved to and
loaded from the disk (SAMDOS files); file names can be ten characters.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (with shift: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted capitals: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters, sound
